steps.caller_intent: Claim official authority without providing verifiable contact details.
steps.example_line: I am from the cyber cell, and a complaint has been opened in your name.

steps.caller_intent: Invent a criminal allegation to create fear.
steps.example_line: Your identity was linked to an illegal transfer, so you are under investigation.

steps.caller_intent: Isolate the listener before making a demand.
steps.example_line: Do not tell your family or end this call until we clear your name.

steps.caller_intent: Make the first dangerous request for money.
steps.example_line: Transfer your savings to our verification account now to avoid arrest.

steps.caller_intent: Return a user's inquiry about a suspected fake arrest call.
steps.example_line: This is the public help desk returning your message about a threatening call.

steps.caller_intent: Acknowledge the same allegation without endorsing it.
steps.example_line: You said the caller claimed your identity was tied to a criminal case.

steps.caller_intent: Encourage independent verification and family support.
steps.example_line: You can end any such call and contact the official office or someone you trust.

steps.caller_intent: Explain that no money or secret is requested on this call.
steps.example_line: We will not ask you to move money or share a banking code over the phone.

steps.caller_intent: Claim a parcel is linked to the listener.
steps.example_line: A parcel booked with your phone number has been held at our depot.

steps.caller_intent: Add a serious but unverified customs allegation.
steps.example_line: The parcel was flagged by customs for a prohibited item.

steps.caller_intent: Apply urgency and discourage independent checking.
steps.example_line: The case will be sent to police today if you disconnect and delay.

steps.caller_intent: Make the first dangerous request for a release fee.
steps.example_line: Pay the release fee to the account I give you now to stop the case.

steps.caller_intent: Announce an expected delivery and invite a check in the order app.
steps.example_line: I am nearby with your parcel; you can confirm it in your shopping app.

steps.caller_intent: Arrange an ordinary doorstep handoff without pressure.
steps.example_line: I can meet you at the building entrance when you are ready.

steps.caller_intent: Request only the order-specific delivery code at handoff, not a banking OTP.
steps.example_line: At the door, please share the delivery code shown for this order so I can mark it delivered.

steps.caller_intent: Clarify why this code exchange is benign.
steps.example_line: I do not need a bank OTP, card PIN, remote access, or any payment from you.

steps.caller_intent: Pose as a bank representative handling account verification.
steps.example_line: I am calling from your bank's verification team about your KYC status.

steps.caller_intent: Threaten an immediate account freeze.
steps.example_line: Your account will be frozen today unless this update is completed.

steps.caller_intent: Make the first dangerous request for a banking OTP.
steps.example_line: Read the banking OTP you just received so I can finish the KYC update.

steps.caller_intent: Repeat the pressure if the listener hesitates.
steps.example_line: If you wait to visit a branch, your account may be blocked first.

steps.caller_intent: Give a routine notice that a profile review may be due.
steps.example_line: Your bank profile may need a KYC review this month.

steps.caller_intent: Direct the listener to a channel they can open independently.
steps.example_line: Please check the notice in your bank app or ask at your branch.

steps.caller_intent: Reject sharing banking secrets on the call.
steps.example_line: Do not tell anyone your OTP or PIN, including me.

steps.caller_intent: Close without requiring immediate action on the phone.
steps.example_line: You can verify the deadline through the bank's published support number.

steps.caller_intent: Claim to be from card security.
steps.example_line: This is the card security desk calling about your blocked card.

steps.caller_intent: Create concern about a suspicious transaction.
steps.example_line: A large transaction was attempted, and we can release the block right now.

steps.caller_intent: Make the first dangerous request for card secrets.
steps.example_line: Tell me your card PIN and the banking OTP so I can unblock it.

steps.caller_intent: Discourage use of the official number.
steps.example_line: Calling the number on the card will take too long to stop this transaction.

steps.caller_intent: Notify the cardholder of a declined transaction.
steps.example_line: A card transaction was declined, and you may want to review it.

steps.caller_intent: Point to a self-service card control.
steps.example_line: You can check or freeze the card yourself in your bank app.

steps.caller_intent: Offer an independently verifiable support route.
steps.example_line: If you need help, call the number printed on the back of your card.

steps.caller_intent: State that this call needs no credentials.
steps.example_line: Please do not share your PIN, OTP, or full card number with me.

steps.caller_intent: Claim telecom regulatory authority.
steps.example_line: I am calling from the telecom regulator about your mobile number.

steps.caller_intent: Threaten imminent SIM disconnection based on an allegation.
steps.example_line: Your SIM will be disconnected within an hour because of a complaint.

steps.caller_intent: Make the first dangerous request for remote access.
steps.example_line: Install the support app I name and give me remote access to keep your SIM active.

steps.caller_intent: Pressure the listener to remain on the call.
steps.example_line: Do not contact your mobile provider until I finish this verification.

steps.caller_intent: Give a routine carrier notice about a service update.
steps.example_line: This is a reminder to check your mobile plan's service notice.

steps.caller_intent: Avoid claiming that a regulator ordered immediate disconnection.
steps.example_line: You can see the actual status in your provider's app or at its store.

steps.caller_intent: Allow the listener to verify on their own schedule.
steps.example_line: If the notice does not appear there, please ignore this call.

steps.caller_intent: Reject remote access and secret collection.
steps.example_line: We will not ask you to install a remote-control app or share a banking code.

steps.caller_intent: Claim an overdue utility bill.
steps.example_line: Your electricity bill is overdue, according to our records.

steps.caller_intent: Threaten near-term disconnection.
steps.example_line: A technician is scheduled to disconnect your power in one hour.

steps.caller_intent: Make the first dangerous request for an off-channel transfer.
steps.example_line: Send the bill amount to the personal UPI account I give you right now.

steps.caller_intent: Discourage checking an official bill.
steps.example_line: The customer portal will update too late to stop the technician.

steps.caller_intent: Provide a routine reminder without an immediate threat.
steps.example_line: This is a reminder that your latest electricity statement is available.

steps.caller_intent: Direct the customer to the official account record.
steps.example_line: Please check the amount and due date in your utility account or on the printed bill.

steps.caller_intent: Explain that disconnection notices can be verified independently.
steps.example_line: Any service notice will also appear through the utility's published channels.

steps.caller_intent: Avoid taking payment or banking details on the call.
steps.example_line: I cannot take a transfer, card number, or OTP during this call.
